scope: Unfunded public mainnet peer discovery, verified chain scan and unpaid receiving-capacity quote; no fee approval, channel funding or payment.

codec_receipt.scope: All original video frames decode with -xerror. Only decoder output timestamps are normalized for the null sink; original recording is unchanged. This does not assert original timestamp/mux timing is warning-free.

transport: Small proof files are copied byte-for-byte into control. Original movie and full xcresult remain once in durable workspace outputs; no media duplication or upload is claimed.
limitations: Simulator evidence does not prove physical authentication or locked-device file protection.
One invalid-frame runtime warning is preserved in the original XCTest summary.
This public iPhone run does not satisfy the pending iPad or maximum accessibility text gates.
